instructions: Season chicken breast and grill 6-7 minutes per side until 165°F internal.
Steam broccoli florets 4-5 minutes until bright green and tender-crisp.
Serve chicken over warm quinoa with broccoli alongside.
Drizzle with olive oil and a squeeze of fresh lemon.
Serve with Gatorade Thirst Quencher (355 g).
